_about: Tutorial stub (lane A6): the basics as steps shown one at a time at the top of the screen, only while Settings > Menus and theme > Learning > Tutorial is on (off by default; Emerson decides after testing). Tutorial (scripts/ui/tutorial.gd) shows the step with the lowest "order" that is not finished and moves on when every item of its "done_when" holds. "done_when" uses the same items as hints.json ("key" with "min", "max" or "is") over MoveHints' state, plus step_s (seconds on this step). "text" names actions in braces, replaced by the player's own binding. A new step is one entry here.

welcome.text: Tutorial: a few steps to get the Juggernaut moving. Turn it off under Settings > Menus and theme.

walk.text: Walk with {move_forward} {strafe_left} {move_back} {strafe_right}. The mouse turns the whole chassis, gun and all.

run.text: Hold {sprint} while you move to gallop.

jump.text: Hold {jump} to charge a jump, then let go.

view.text: Press {camera_view} to look out from the cockpit.

view_back.text: Press {camera_view} again to step back out.

fire.text: {fire_main} fires the 57 mm, {fire_sub} the sub-arm guns. That's the basics; the move hints carry on from here.
